"Cloud bills just go up as your business grows."

It is an accepted truth for many founders, but it doesn't have to be.

More often than not, rising cloud costs come from accumulated waste rather than actual scale: forgotten staging servers, oversized databases, and unoptimized data storage that quietly run month after month.

Before you add more budget to your infrastructure, take a look at what is already running. Turning off non-production environments outside working hours and matching server sizes to actual usage can noticeably lower your monthly spend.
